body:
Code looks good to me! Great work!

Haven't tested the functionality

Moving the files menu to the top was attempted in #105183, but it missed the visual shader editor and got reverted. It makes sense to me to have them all consistently at the top.

Making the Shader Editor menus more similar to the Script Editor menus makes sense too.
Some new ones and some I might have missed

Looks good!
Couldn't find any more issues when testing.
I don't like how the ShaderEditor is a ScriptEditor, but changing that would be too big so it can be a follow-up.
